---
title: "Citation and release"
---

If this project helps your work, cite the paper and archive release:

```bibtex
@article{sao2026exactlimits,
  title  = {Exact Limits of Random Projections for Preserving Geometry:
            Distance Recovery, Nearest-Neighbor Rankings, and Covariance
            Shape in Gaussian Models},
  author = {Sao, Piyush},
  year   = {2026}
}
```

Versioned public releases are designed for Zenodo archival. `CITATION.cff`
provides machine-readable metadata; DOI fields will be updated at public launch.

The code is MIT licensed. The manuscript and its text remain governed by the
terms stated in the paper repository.
